mapper.select: SELECT MENU_ID ,HI_MNU_ID ,MNU_NM ,MNU_NM_EN ,MNU_URL ,ORD_PRI ,MNU_DES ,LINK_TP FROM TB_SYME001 WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId}

SELECT MN.MENU_ID ,(SELECT MNU_NM FROM TB_SYME001 PMN WHERE MN.HI_MNU_ID = PMN.MENU_ID) AS HI_MNU_NM ,MN.MNU_NM ,MN.MNU_NM_EN ,MN.MNU_URL ,MN.ORD_PRI ,MN.MNU_DES ,MN.LINK_TP FROM TB_SYME001 MN WHERE MN.HI_MNU_ID != '' ORDER BY MN.HI_MNU_ID, MN.ORD_PRI;

SELECT MN.MENU_ID ,(SELECT MNU_NM FROM TB_SYME001 PMN WHERE HI_MNU_ID = MN.MENU_ID AND MN.HI_MNU_ID != '') AS HI_MNU_NM ,MN.HI_MNU_ID ,MN.MNU_NM ,MN.MNU_NM_EN ,MN.MNU_URL ,MN.ORD_PRI ,MN.MNU_DES ,MN.LINK_TP FROM TB_SYME001 MN
ORDER BY MN.HI_MNU_ID, MN.ORD_PRI LIMIT #{searchCond.pageItemSize} OFFSET #{searchCond.start}
